header: Develop and formalize use case process
content:
Once a high-level use case standard has been defined and approved, the next step is to create and
test an actual use case. The following sections use anti-phishing and threat and vulnerability scanning
scenarios as examples.
The first step in creating a use case is to outline the workflow using a story board. Here's an example
of a high-level story board for a new phishing exploit notification to a Threat Intelligence team.
Once the story board has been approved, the next step is to invoke the use case workflow. Here's an
example process for an anti-phishing campaign.
